novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new mechanism—jailbreaks are said to be "artificially COLLAPSING this safety-verdict uncertainty to false confidence" while harmfulness belief remains intact—and a corresponding measurement/intervention object distinct from harmfulness and refusal directions. Searches using "jailbreak safety verdict uncertainty activations," "LLM jailbreak confidence hidden state," "uncertainty activation steering refusal," and "metacognitive confidence jailbreak defense" found the closest precedents in Calibrating LLM Judges: Linear Probes for Fast and Reliable Uncertainty Estimation, Refusal in LLMs is an Affine Function, and Beyond Linear Probes: Dynamic Safety Monitoring for Language Models; these separately cover hidden-state uncertainty, refusal steering, or ambiguous-input monitoring, but not uncertainty about the model's own safety classification as a causal jailbreak pathway. Moving from those works to the asserted belief-high/uncertainty-low mechanism requires a new core relationship rather than a direct transfer, although the linear-direction extraction and activation re-injection themselves are standard tools, supporting high but not paradigm-level novelty.
